title: Partner Onboarding SOP Cleanup
question:
Using Notion Tools. Complete the "Partner Onboarding SOP" template so it becomes a ready-to-use operating procedure for the Strategic Partner Onboarding Process.
**Task Requirements:** 1. Update the SOP header information:
   - Change the placeholder heading "SOP Title" to "Strategic Partner
     Onboarding Process"
   - Change the created date to "2025-04-15"
   - Change the responsible department to "Partnership Operations"

2. Update the callout block near the top of the Partnership Operations
   Team Wiki page so it explains that this SOP standardizes intake,
   legal review, implementation handoff, launch readiness, and post-launch
   ownership for every strategic partner.

3. Fill in the Purpose section of the Partner Onboarding SOP with a
   paragraph explaining that the process exists to coordinate partner
   intake, verify compliance requirements, prepare implementation teams,
   and create a reliable handoff from signed agreement to active launch.

4. Fill in the Procedure section with a numbered list in this exact order:
   1. Confirm that the partner has a completed intake record in the Partner
      Intake Checklist page.
   2. Review the required contract and compliance items in the Legal Review
      Guide page.
   3. Assign an implementation owner and create the first handoff note in
      the Implementation Handoff database.
   4. Schedule a launch readiness review and document unresolved blockers
      before activation.
   5. Move the partner to active ownership only after all launch checklist
      items are complete.

5. Every reference in the Procedure section to Partner Intake Checklist,
   Legal Review Guide, and Implementation Handoff must be an @-mention or
   link-to-page/database reference, not plain text.

6. Reorganize the existing sections in the Partner Onboarding SOP:
   - Move the "Escalation Path" section so it appears before the "Success
     Criteria" section.
   - Preserve all existing child blocks under both sections.
   - Preserve the text, formatting, and relative order of the child blocks
     within each moved section.

7. Convert the "Related Resources" section into a toggle block titled
   "Related Resources". Move any existing child pages currently under that
   section into the toggle, below the reorganized SOP sections.

8. In the Partner Knowledge Base database on the Partnership Operations
    Team Wiki page, find every page whose "Review Status" property contains
    "Expired". Do not update the page named "Archived Partner FAQ".

9. For each matching Partner Knowledge Base page from step 8, insert a
    callout block as the first child block of that page with:
    - Icon: ⚠️
    - Background color: yellow_background
    - Text: "This partner resource needs review before it can be used in
      the Strategic Partner Onboarding Process."

10. In the Partnership Requests database, create a new record titled
    "Partner onboarding resource review".
    - Priority: High
    - Status: Not started
    - Inside the page body, add a bulleted list with one bullet per
      processed Partner Knowledge Base page.
    - Each bullet must reference the processed page using an @-mention or
      link-to-page reference and include a short note explaining why the
      resource needs review.
